Shri Raghav Shrivastava, learned Govt. Advocate for t  respondents/State.

By this petition preferred under Article 226 of the Constitution of India the petitioner has prayed for the following reliefs :-
"(A) Issue a Writ, Order or Direction in the nature of a Mandamus or any other appropriate Writ, Order or Direction directing the Respondents to not dispossess the Petitioner Firm from the land and property situated at Survey No. 183, Village Sirpur,
Tehsil Malharganj, District Indore (M.P.) ('subject property') unless the provisions of the Act of 2013 are fully and properly complied with; AND (B) Pass any other order this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and necessary, in the interest ofjustice and good faith."
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the objection NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:25258 2 WP-34950-2025 of the petitioner has been decided vide Annexure P/8.

However without taking the further proceedings as contemplated under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 the petitioner is being threatened with forcible dispossession.

4. It is hence observed that the respondents shall duly comply with the provision and the procedure prescribed under the Act, 2013 in the matter of proceeding ahead with the proceedings initiated under the Act, 2013 and shall take consequent action only by following the same.

5. With the aforesaid observation, the petition stands disposed off.
